description: This file implements an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache in Go, including cache data structures, methods for adding, retrieving, removing, and clearing cache entries, and optional eviction callback handling.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Represents an LRU cache with configurable maximum entries, optional eviction callback, and internal linked list and map for cache management.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Cache instance with specified maximum entries.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the cache, updating position if key exists, and evicting oldest if limit exceeded.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key, moving the accessed item to the front as most recently used.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a specific key from the cache.

methods.name: RemoveOldest
methods.description: Removes the least recently used item from the cache.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the current number of items in the cache.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all cache entries, optionally invoking eviction callback for each.
